shame.zh: 憾事、可惜（常用 It's a shame）

ai: The shocking news spread quickly through the town.
這個令人震驚的消息很快傳遍了全鎮。
It is shocking how little the workers were paid.
那些工人的薪水之低，令人震驚。
Speaking in public terrifies me.
在公開場合說話讓我非常恐懼。
The tragic accident took the lives of three people.
那起悲慘的意外奪走了三條人命。
It is tragic that so many young people die in car crashes.
這麼多年輕人死於車禍，實在令人悲痛。
After years abroad, he yearned for his hometown.
在國外多年後，他很思念故鄉。
The weary travelers finally reached the inn.
疲憊的旅人終於抵達了旅店。
She gave a weary smile after the long shift.
漫長的班結束後，她露出疲倦的微笑。
The long meeting wearied everyone.
冗長的會議讓大家都累壞了。
He wearied of the noisy city and moved to the countryside.
他厭倦了吵鬧的城市，搬到了鄉下。

alarming.zh: 令人憂心的、令人驚慌的
ai: The number of cases is rising at an alarming rate.
病例數正以令人憂心的速度增加。
It is alarming how quickly the ice is melting.
冰融化的速度之快，令人擔憂。
There is growing discontent among the workers.
工人之間的不滿正日益升高。
He could not hide his discontent with the result.
他無法掩飾對結果的不滿。
The smell from the garbage was disgusting.
垃圾的氣味令人作嘔。
He made a dubious claim that nobody could verify.
他提出了一個沒人能證實的可疑說法。
The teacher frowned when he saw the messy homework.
老師看到凌亂的作業時皺起了眉頭。
Many people frown on talking loudly on the train.
許多人不贊成在火車上大聲講話。
She read the letter with a deep frown.
她皺著眉頭讀完那封信。
A frown crossed his face when he heard the price.
他一聽到價錢，臉上就露出不悅的表情。
The two drivers glared at each other after the near collision.
兩名駕駛在險些相撞後怒目相視。
The glare of the sun made it hard to see the road.
太陽的刺眼強光讓人難以看清道路。
She hesitantly raised her hand to ask a question.
她遲疑地舉起手想問問題。
He answered hesitantly, as if he wasn't sure.
他遲疑地回答，好像不太確定。
His indecision cost the team a lot of time.
他的優柔寡斷使團隊浪費了很多時間。
After a moment of indecision, she chose the blue dress.
猶豫了一會兒之後，她選了那件藍色洋裝。
She watched the match keenly from the front row.
她在前排專注地觀看比賽。
He felt keenly the loss of his old friend.
他深切感受到失去老朋友的痛苦。
Villagers lamented the loss of their old school.
村民們為失去老學校而悲嘆。
Many people lament the decline of traditional crafts.
許多人感嘆傳統工藝的沒落。
The song is a lament for a lost love.
這首歌是為逝去的愛情而唱的悲歌。
Her lament echoed through the empty hall.
她的哀嘆聲在空蕩蕩的大廳裡迴盪。
The old man felt lonesome after his wife passed away.
老先生在妻子過世後覺得很寂寞。
A lonesome tree stood on the hill.
山丘上孤零零地立著一棵樹。
The wine has a rich, mellow flavor.
這支酒的味道濃郁香醇。
The singer has a warm, mellow voice.
這位歌手的嗓音溫暖柔和。
He has grown mellow with age.
他隨著年紀增長變得隨和圓熟。
The injured man moaned in pain.
受傷的男子痛苦地呻吟。
Stop moaning about the weather and enjoy the trip.
別再抱怨天氣，好好享受旅程吧。
We heard a low moan from the next room.
我們聽見隔壁房間傳來低低的呻吟聲。
The wind made a long moan through the trees.
風在樹林間發出長長的嗚咽聲。
In the story, a monstrous creature lived under the bridge.
故事裡，橋底下住著一隻怪物般的可怕生物。
The dictator was responsible for monstrous crimes.
那名獨裁者犯下了駭人聽聞的罪行。
The difficult riddle perplexed all the students.
這個困難的謎語讓所有學生都百思不解。
His strange behavior perplexed his friends.
他古怪的行為讓朋友們摸不著頭腦。
He was fined for reckless behavior on the road.
他因為在路上魯莽的行為而被罰款。
She relished the chance to travel alone.
她很享受獨自旅行的機會。
I don't relish the idea of getting up at five.
我可不喜歡五點起床這個主意。
He ate his dinner with great relish.
他津津有味地吃著晚餐。
She took no relish in other people's mistakes.
她不會以別人的錯誤為樂。
He resents having to work on weekends.
他不滿自己得在週末加班。
I had a rotten day at work and just want to go home.
我今天上班糟透了，只想回家。
The poet's sensibility to nature shows in every line.
詩人對自然的敏銳感受力呈現在每一行詩句中。
Her artistic sensibility made her a fine designer.
她的藝術感受力使她成為出色的設計師。
He keeps the old letters for sentimental reasons.
他因為情感上的原因留著那些舊信。
She gets sentimental whenever she hears that song.
她一聽到那首歌就變得多愁善感。
She has long, slender fingers.
她有一雙修長纖細的手指。
The model was tall and slender.
那位模特兒又高又苗條。
His sloppy handwriting is hard to read.
他潦草的字跡很難辨認。
The writer moved to a cabin in the mountains to enjoy solitude.
那位作家搬到山中小屋，享受獨處的時光。
The drunk man staggered down the street.
醉漢搖搖晃晃地走在街上。
She staggered under the weight of the heavy bag.
她被沉重的袋子壓得步履蹣跚。
The bread was stale after a week in the cupboard.
麵包在櫥櫃裡放了一週後就不新鮮了。
The wound is only superficial and will heal soon.
傷口只是表皮傷，很快就會癒合。
The two brothers have very different temperaments.
這兩兄弟的性情很不一樣。
A calm temperament is important for a nurse.
沉穩的性格對護理師來說很重要。

thrilling.zh: 令人激動的、驚險刺激的
ai: It was a thrilling match that went into extra time.
那是一場進入延長賽的緊張刺激的比賽。
The roller coaster ride was thrilling.
雲霄飛車很刺激。
Filling out the same form again and again is tiresome.
一再重複填寫同一份表格實在令人厭煩。
The troublesome child kept interrupting the lesson.
那個調皮搗蛋的孩子一直打斷上課。

undesirable.zh: 令人不快的、不受歡迎的
ai: The medicine has some undesirable side effects.
這種藥有一些令人不快的副作用。
The landlord refused to rent to undesirable tenants.
房東拒絕把房子租給不受歡迎的房客。
The trip to Japan was an unforgettable experience.
日本之旅是一次難忘的經驗。
His constant lateness vexed his boss.
他老是遲到，讓老闆很惱火。
It vexes me that nobody listens to my advice.
沒有人聽我的建議，讓我很氣惱。
He still works with the vigor of a young man.
他工作起來仍然像年輕人一樣精力充沛。
The team returned to the field with new vigor.
球隊帶著新的活力回到場上。
She shook her head vigorously to say no.
她用力地搖頭表示不同意。
The company vigorously denied the rumors.
公司強烈否認了這些謠言。
The crowd cheered wildly when the band appeared.
樂團出場時，群眾瘋狂歡呼。
His heart was beating wildly.
他的心臟狂跳不已。
The decision displeased many members of the committee.
這項決定讓許多委員很不高興。
He was careful not to displease his boss.
他小心翼翼不去惹老闆不高興。
It is shameful to cheat on an exam.
考試作弊是可恥的。
The way they treated the guests was shameful.
他們對待客人的方式很丟臉。
The ground began to quake under our feet.
我們腳下的地面開始震動。
He quaked with fear when he heard footsteps behind him.
他聽到背後有腳步聲時嚇得發抖。
A strong quake shook the city at dawn.
黎明時分一場強烈地震撼動了這座城市。
Many buildings were damaged by the quake.
許多建築物在地震中受損。
It's an old superstition that breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
打破鏡子會帶來厄運是個古老的迷信。
Some athletes are superstitious and wear the same socks every game.
有些運動員很迷信，每場比賽都穿同一雙襪子。
My grandmother is superstitious about the number four.
我奶奶對數字四很迷信。
He awkwardly tried to hide the gift behind his back.
他笨手笨腳地想把禮物藏在背後。
They stood awkwardly in the doorway, not knowing what to say.
他們尷尬地站在門口，不知道該說什麼。
Adding sugar cuts the bitterness of the tea.
加糖可以減輕茶的苦味。
There was a note of bitterness in his voice.
他的聲音裡帶著一絲怨恨。
The cunning thief fooled the guards with a fake uniform.
狡猾的小偷穿著假制服騙過了警衛。
The building is distinctively shaped like a boat.
這棟建築物形狀獨特，像一艘船。
She dresses distinctively, always in bright yellow.
她穿著獨樹一格，總是一身亮黃色。
The beauty of the island enchanted every visitor.
小島的美景讓每位遊客都為之著迷。
The storyteller enchanted the children with tales of dragons.
說書人用龍的故事迷住了孩子們。
The survey asked whether participants were heterosexual or not.
這份調查詢問受訪者是否為異性戀者。
They are a heterosexual couple with two children.
他們是一對異性戀夫妻，有兩個孩子。
She was indignant at being accused of lying.
她對被指控說謊感到憤慨。
The customers grew indignant when the shop refused to refund their money.
商店拒絕退款，讓顧客們非常憤慨。
I heard indistinct voices in the next room.
我聽到隔壁房間傳來模糊不清的說話聲。
In the fog, the outline of the ship was indistinct.
在霧中，船的輪廓很模糊。
The carpet has an intricate pattern of flowers.
這塊地毯有複雜精細的花朵圖案。
The luminous numbers on the clock glowed in the dark.
時鐘上的夜光數字在黑暗中發亮。
She had luminous eyes that seemed to shine.
她有一雙明亮的眼睛，彷彿會發光。
The boy miraculously survived the fall.
那個男孩奇蹟般地在墜落中存活下來。
Miraculously, nobody was hurt in the crash.
奇蹟般地，車禍中沒有人受傷。
The whole nation rejoiced when the war ended.
戰爭結束時，全國都歡欣鼓舞。

streak.zh: 一系列、一連串（的好運或壞運）
ai: The team is on a five-game winning streak.
這支球隊正處於五連勝。
He is having a streak of bad luck.
他最近一直走霉運。
Tears streaked her face.
淚水在她臉上留下一道道痕跡。
The triumphant team lifted the trophy over their heads.
獲勝的球隊把獎盃高舉過頭。
He gave a triumphant smile after winning the argument.
他在辯論獲勝後露出得意的微笑。
The widower raised his three children alone.
那位鰥夫獨自撫養三個孩子。
The family returned to their ancestral home every spring.
這家人每年春天都回到祖宅。
They visited the ancestral graves during the festival.
他們在節日期間去祭拜祖先的墳墓。
She felt a growing apprehension as the exam date approached.
考試日期愈來愈近，她愈來愈擔心。
He waited with apprehension for the doctor's call.
他憂心忡忡地等著醫生的電話。
The police announced the apprehension of the suspect.
警方宣布嫌犯已被逮捕。
The apprehension of the thief took only an hour.
抓到那名小偷只花了一個小時。
The bleak landscape was covered with snow and ice.
荒涼的景色被冰雪覆蓋。
The future looks bleak for the small company.
這家小公司的前景看起來黯淡。
He tried to flatter the boss to get a promotion.
他想奉承老闆來換取升遷。
I was flattered that she remembered my name.
她記得我的名字，讓我受寵若驚。
She grieved for her husband for many years.
她為丈夫哀悼了很多年。
It grieves me to see you so unhappy.
看到你這麼不快樂，我很難過。
The students groaned when the teacher announced a test.
老師宣布要考試，學生們都哀嚎了起來。
He let out a groan of pain and sat down.
他發出一聲痛苦的呻吟並坐了下來。
A groan went through the crowd when the team lost.
球隊輸球時，觀眾席上傳來一陣哀嘆聲。
The workers grumbled about the long hours.
工人們抱怨工時太長。
He grumbled all the way home about the bad service.
他一路抱怨著糟糕的服務回家。
Years of war left the two groups full of hatred.
多年的戰爭使這兩個族群充滿敵意。
She looked at him with hatred in her eyes.
她眼裡帶著恨意看著他。
I had a lousy night's sleep because of the noise.
因為噪音，我昨晚睡得很糟。
The food at that restaurant is lousy.
那家餐廳的食物很難吃。
The little boy had a look of mischief in his eyes.
那個小男孩眼裡閃著淘氣的神色。
The twins are always up to mischief.
這對雙胞胎總是在搞惡作劇。
Who is sober enough to drive us home?
誰清醒得足以開車送我們回家？
The news gave us a sober reminder of the risks.
這則新聞讓我們嚴肅地意識到風險。
He wore a sober dark suit to the funeral.
他穿了一套樸素的深色西裝出席葬禮。
I sympathize with parents who have to work two jobs.
我同情那些得打兩份工的父母。
The complicated map bewildered the tourists.
複雜的地圖讓遊客一頭霧水。
His sudden anger bewildered his family.
他突如其來的憤怒讓家人困惑不已。
It was an absorbing novel that I couldn't put down.
那是一本引人入勝、讓我放不下的小說。
The documentary was absorbing from beginning to end.
這部紀錄片從頭到尾都很吸引人。
Some dogs show aggression toward strangers.
有些狗對陌生人表現出攻擊性。
The coach told the players to channel their aggression into the game.
教練要球員把他們的攻擊性轉化到比賽中。
He cried out in agony when the doctor touched his leg.
醫生一碰到他的腿，他就痛得大叫。
The family waited in agony for news of the missing boy.
全家人痛苦地等待著失蹤男孩的消息。
I wanted to go to the concert, but, alas, the tickets were sold out.
我想去聽演唱會，但是唉，票賣完了。
The driver was not blameworthy because the brakes failed.
駕駛不應受責備，因為煞車失靈了。
Nobody is blameworthy for an honest mistake.
誠實犯下的錯誤不該怪罪於任何人。
I have no reason to disbelieve her story.
我沒有理由不相信她的說法。
Many people disbelieve the claim that the product is completely safe.
許多人不相信這項產品完全安全的說法。
The coach humiliated the player in front of the whole team.
教練當著全隊的面羞辱那名球員。
He humorously described his first day at work.
他幽默地描述自己上班的第一天。
The book humorously explains how to survive a family dinner.
這本書用幽默的筆法說明如何撐過家庭聚餐。
The ceremony marked the boys' passage into manhood.
這個儀式標誌著男孩們邁入成年。
He felt his manhood was being challenged.
他覺得自己的男子氣概受到了挑戰。
A murmur of surprise went through the room.
房間裡響起一陣驚訝的低語聲。
She murmured a prayer before going to sleep.
她睡前低聲念了一段禱詞。
The steak was cooked to perfection.
那塊牛排煎得恰到好處。
Cutting the education budget is a shortsighted decision.
削減教育預算是個目光短淺的決定。
It was shortsighted of him to ignore the long-term costs.
他忽略了長期成本，實在是目光短淺。
She is shortsighted and cannot read the board without glasses.
她近視，不戴眼鏡就看不清黑板。
Many shortsighted children wear glasses.
許多近視的孩子都戴眼鏡。
It was a small consolation that nobody was hurt.
沒有人受傷，多少算是一點安慰。
She found consolation in music after her loss.
她在失去親人後從音樂中找到慰藉。
The despairing farmer watched his crops die in the drought.
絕望的農夫眼睜睜看著莊稼在乾旱中枯死。
She sent a despairing look to her friend across the room.
她向房間另一頭的朋友投去絕望的一瞥。
We need a disinterested judge to settle the dispute.
我們需要一位公正無私的法官來解決爭端。
The advice was disinterested; he had nothing to gain.
這個建議是無私的，他沒有任何好處可得。
To my dismay, the shop was already closed.
讓我沮喪的是，那家店已經關門了。
The poor results dismayed the whole team.
糟糕的成績讓整個團隊沮喪不已。
We were dismayed to find the road blocked.
我們發現路被封住了，感到驚愕。
The streets were full of gaiety during the festival.
節慶期間街上充滿歡樂的氣氛。
Her gaiety lifted everyone's spirits.
她的歡樂讓大家的精神都振奮起來。
The unfair decision caused public indignation.
這個不公平的決定引起了眾怒。
She spoke with indignation about the way workers were treated.
她憤慨地談起工人受到的對待。
The baby gets irritable when he is tired.
寶寶累了就會鬧脾氣。
The meek boy never argued with anyone.
那個溫順的男孩從來不跟人爭執。
She gave a meek reply and looked at the floor.
她低聲下氣地回答並看著地板。
A feeling of melancholy came over him as autumn arrived.
秋天一到，他心中湧起一股憂鬱。
The old song filled her with melancholy.
那首老歌使她充滿憂傷。
He wore a melancholy expression all day.
他整天都帶著憂鬱的神情。
The melancholy music matched the rainy evening.
憂傷的音樂與雨夜十分相配。
She broke the monotony of office work by taking up painting.
她靠學畫畫來打破辦公室工作的單調。
The monotony of the long drive made him sleepy.
長途駕駛的單調讓他昏昏欲睡。
The whole country mourned the death of the famous singer.
全國都在哀悼那位知名歌手的逝世。
There is a growing sense of pessimism about the economy.
人們對經濟的悲觀情緒日益升高。
Her pessimism made it hard for her to enjoy the trip.
她的悲觀讓她很難享受這趟旅行。
Money problems preoccupied him all week.
金錢問題整週佔據了他的心思。
The upcoming exam preoccupies most of the students.
即將來臨的考試讓大部分學生心事重重。
The photos from the disaster were horrifying.
災難現場的照片令人毛骨悚然。
It was a horrifying thought that he might never come home.
想到他可能再也回不了家，真是可怕。
He is so conceited that he thinks everyone admires him.
他自大到以為每個人都很欽佩他。
Nobody likes a conceited person who only talks about himself.
沒有人喜歡只談論自己的自負之人。
Stealing from the poor is a contemptible act.
偷窮人的東西是卑劣的行為。
I think his lies about the accident were contemptible.
我認為他關於這起事故的謊言很可鄙。
Running away was an act of cowardice.
逃跑是懦弱的行為。
He was ashamed of his cowardice during the fire.
他為自己在火災中的怯懦感到羞愧。
He still remembers the humiliation of failing in front of his class.
他仍記得在全班面前失敗的羞辱。
The team suffered a humiliation in a 10-0 defeat.
球隊以 0 比 10 慘敗，備受羞辱。
Dark clouds gathered, giving an ominous sign of a storm.
烏雲聚集，預示著暴風雨即將來臨。
An ominous silence followed his words.
他說完後出現了一陣不祥的沉默。
The stranger gave him a sinister smile.
那個陌生人對他露出陰險的笑容。
There was something sinister about the empty house.
那棟空屋有種不祥的氣氛。
It's ungrateful to complain after all the help you received.
得到這麼多幫助之後還抱怨，就是忘恩負義。
Her ungrateful son never called to say thank you.
她那個忘恩負義的兒子從來沒打電話道謝。
The cruelty of the crime will appal anyone who reads about it.
任何讀到這起罪行的人都會為其殘忍而驚駭。
Such wasteful spending would appal most taxpayers.
這種浪費的開支會讓大多數納稅人感到震驚。
The prisoners lived in appalling conditions.
囚犯們生活在駭人的環境中。
His behavior at the party was appalling.
他在派對上的行為令人震驚。
She spread malicious gossip about her coworkers.
她散播關於同事的惡意流言。
The fire was the result of a malicious act.
這場火災是惡意縱火的結果。

hysterical.zh: 歇斯底里的、情緒失控的
ai: The hysterical crowd rushed toward the exit.
歇斯底里的群眾衝向出口。
She became hysterical when she heard the news.
她聽到消息時情緒失控了。
The comedian's story was absolutely hysterical.
那位喜劇演員的故事實在笑死人了。
We watched a hysterical movie last night.
我們昨晚看了一部超爆笑的電影。
He conceitedly announced that he was the best player on the team.
他自負地宣稱自己是隊上最好的球員。
She smiled conceitedly at the praise.
她得意自負地對讚美微笑。
The old photographs filled him with nostalgia.
那些老照片讓他充滿懷舊之情。
She felt a wave of nostalgia for her school days.
她對學生時代湧起一陣懷念之情。
